offering_description.value: Gencor manufactures asphalt plants, soil remediation plants, combustion systems, heat transfer systems, and equipment parts for road and highway contractors. It provides post-sale technical support and hands-on training in hot-mix asphalt production.

quotes.quote: Gencor is the leading manufacturer of asphalt plants, soil remediation plants, combustion systems and heat transfer systems to the road and highway construction industry. For over a century, Gencor has worked with highway Contractors in innovating technologies that have shaped highway construction industry standards.

Gencor Industries, Inc. offers a distinct advantage in the road and highway construction industries by manufacturing top-quality equipment and parts, and providing the best possible post-sale customer support and training available.
